text.tspan: One dome, one room. The thirteen-day run happens
on a single floor under a hexagonal shell: every
station the crew need stands in reach of every
other, and nothing is resupplied after the hatch
is sealed.
Each station feeds the record. The sensors
post what the room is doing, the officers
write what they did, and every store visibly
empties across the run. The numbers key
every view on this sheet to the same ten
stations.

svg.text: the ten stations on the deployed hexagon platform
shell over platform — the state the run opens in
the numbered work cells, one per station
deployable hexagons on the light frame

text.tspan: Power is made in the room: the crew pedal
the cycle (09), the array outside (10)
harvests the sky; both charge one battery.
Water circles through the recycler (08);
every store's level stands on the front page
as days remaining.
Greens grow on the racks (07), live protein
in the terrarium (06), cooked at (05) as the
day's meal plan.
Three astronauts — communication, science,
health — sleep in the pods and file the
record daily.
The dome forms one pressurised room —
every station in reach of every other

svg.text: the uplink from Earth lands here
